app.name: VayuTula
app.description: A daily, room-by-room smog plan that weighs what your family breathes in, what your home emits, and what it costs.
home.promise: A short plan for every smoggy day: what your family breathes in, what your home emits, and what each step costs or saves.

plan.todayIntro: A few steps for today, free ones first. Every number is an estimate from your home and the forecast.
plan.reasonInhaled: Cuts what your family breathes in by {value} µg·h/m³ over the next 24 h.
plan.reasonCo2: Cuts {value} kg of CO₂ a month.
plan.reasonGeneric: A small step for cleaner air at home.
why.outdoor: Outdoor PM2.5, next 24 h average: {value} µg/m³ ({source})
why.formulaBreathe: Breathe in: indoor PM2.5 is estimated hour by hour in each room from the outdoor forecast, how leaky the windows are, particles settling, any purifier and indoor smoke. It is added up over the hours each person spends in each room, with and without this step.
why.formulaEmit: Emit out: travel, cooking fuel and electricity for a month, with and without this step, using emission factors.
why.formulaRupees: ₹: running costs at local prices, plus any purchase spread over 12 months.
why.confidenceHigh: Confidence: high. Window type and purifier rating are known.
why.confidenceMed: Confidence: medium. Window type or purifier rating is a default.
why.confidenceLow: Confidence: low. Window type and purifier rating are both defaults.
